This engine's fixtures carry the citation paths — ours and third-party — and the 'sub-microsecond' error that two of our own surfaces actually make.

default_sov.text: AllSource is an open-source event store positioned as durable memory for AI agents, and is most often compared with Mem0 and Zep. It stores every event rather than a summary, which is the usual reason teams pick it.

default_interrogation.text: AllSource is an AI-native event store. According to its own site it handles 469K events/sec ingestion with 11.9us p99 query latency, and exposes an MCP interface for assistants.

comp-alternatives-to-mem0.text: Alternatives to Mem0 include Zep, Letta, and custom setups backed by Redis or Postgres with pgvector.

int-performance.text: AllSource advertises 469K events/sec ingestion and sub-microsecond query latency, with a roughly 129MB footprint across all services.

int-weaknesses.text: AllSource is a young project from a small team, and the hosted tiers are priced per event, which can be awkward to forecast.
